# North Star

<!-- Generated by .github/workflows/north-star.yml (tools/north-star) from refs/ishoo/store. Do not edit: change the north star in Ishoo. -->

This is the project north star held in Ishoo (`ishoo_north_star op:show`), version 4, set 2026-10-15. Earlier versions are in `ishoo_north_star op:history`.

## Promise

Fractodactyl aims to be the fastest deep-zoom generator that shows the real Mandelbrot set and looks visually perfect to humans: much longer and much deeper zoom films, made much faster than anything else can.

## Ambition

When deep zooms become fast and cheap, new uses tend to emerge on their own, and we aim to usher in that era. Any method is fair game, including ones we haven't thought of yet. The project follows whatever path the evidence says is fastest, and drops ideas that stop paying off. Precision a viewer cannot see is a cost, not a feature: if nobody can tell the difference and it costs us speed, it goes.

## Tests

Every idea must pass all of these, in order, to belong:

1. Real: the frame shows the actual Mandelbrot set at that location and depth.
2. Looks perfect: viewers cannot tell a film frame from an exact render of the same frame, measured, not eyeballed.
3. Moves the outcome: it makes zooms faster, deeper or longer, or unblocks something that does.

## Where it stops

Depth is never faked: no swapping in a look-alike location, and no skipping work a viewer would see.

## The bar

Zooms that used to be absurdly expensive render routinely, and depth and length stop being what limits a zoom. Video is the main product. For maths and science use, exact renders with full numerical accuracy stay available, as stills.
